CB21-054.name: Ikari Gendo
CB21-054.effect:
[Grandwalker Nexus]
This Nexus can only be affected by effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses. Cores can only be placed on this Nexus via Core Charge or effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses, and cannot be moved from this Nexus except via effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses.

[Core Charge] (NERV & Cost 3 or more) (Purple & Brave) ("Ikari Yui" & Nexus)
◆When you summon/advent/deploy a target Spirit/Brave/Nexus, you can put one core from the Void onto this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you don't control a Nexus with the same card name as this card, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, place one core from the Void onto this Nexus.

[Grand Skill: 4] [LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
(Send four cores from this Nexus to the Void) Draw two cards. This effect can only be used once per turn.

[Grand Field] [LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your Spirit braved to four Braves attacks, you can send every core from this Nexus to the Void. When you've done so, send three cores each from the opposing Life/Field to the Void, and return one of your set exactly-named "Ikari Yui" to the Hand.
